basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Engineering Leader · Production AI Platforms · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 13+ years scaling production systems and multi-team delivery (10M+ users at Beekeeper, $1.5M+ ARR products at 99.99% SLA). Operates as the trusted execution partner: ships platforms end-to-end, runs delivery cadence across multiple teams, owns vendor spend. Founder of three companies including PulseView (real-time AI market intelligence with explainable trading signals) and SwissNRI (compliance-first cross-border fintech across Swiss and Indian regulatory regimes). MBA-trained on translating technical risk, budget, and timeline into board-ready decisions.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress. Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement.
Led end-to-end from architecture (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP) through rollout. Built production AI agents driving 2x open rates and forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter.
Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Surfaces business patterns that drive strategy across product, sales, and CS.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead operating across multiple teams and divisions. Owned architecture, delivery cadence, hiring, and platform consolidation for AI-powered products used by millions.
highlights: Led Search Platform revamp across 3 engineering teams. Redesigned indexing and ranking, aligned stakeholders, delivered on schedule. Measurable lift in user engagement.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated since Jan 2024. Direct vendor spend control.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort as acting hiring manager. Hired for craft and curiosity, grew engineers who now lead features independently. Deputy tech lead of FUEL.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on scaling, AI adoption, and trading infrastructure.
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production. Low-latency distributed systems, deployment cadence, operational resilience.
Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions. Same lens used in M&A technical due diligence.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built the platform, cloud infrastructure, and real-time control APIs from scratch.
highlights: Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents across 500+ live flights.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Research engineer on Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems. Owned the AWS scale-out and mentored students.
highlights: Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time stock market analysis platform: AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals using technical and news-based data. Built for my own trading portfolio first, opened to retail traders after self-validation.
highlights: Real-time market analysis via AI agents that generate and justify trading signals using technical and news-based data. Live users on real-time market feeds.
Core product principle: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Explainability over complexity, controls-by-design from day one.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Compliance-first SaaS for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations. First digital platform addressing this cross-border regulatory surface.
highlights: Compliance-first architecture: regulatory guardrails for both Swiss and Indian jurisdictions built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for, not what was easy to build.

highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data. One workflow, zero copy-paste.
